title: Detailed paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='9' fill='#1a4a6e' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Hull bottom - main boat body -->
  <polygon points='18,68 50,84 82,68 50,58' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  
  <!-- Hull left side (lit) -->
  <polygon points='18,68 50,84 50,68' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  
  <!-- Hull right side (shaded) -->
  <polygon points='82,68 50,84 50,68' fill='#c8bfa8'/>
  
  <!-- Hull inner shadow line -->
  <polygon points='50,68 50,74 62,70' fill='#b0a68e' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Sail - left panel (bright) -->
  <polygon points='50,58 50,18 22,58' fill='#fff8ee'/>
  
  <!-- Sail - left panel edge highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,58 50,18 22,58' fill='none' stroke='#d4cbb8' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Sail - right panel (shaded) -->
  <polygon points='50,58 50,18 78,58' fill='#d8cfbe'/>
  
  <!-- Sail middle fold crease -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='58' stroke='#b8ad95' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Sail diagonal creases left -->
  <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='32' y2='55' stroke='#e0d6c2' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='40' x2='36' y2='56' stroke='#e0d6c2' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Sail diagonal creases right -->
  <line x1='50' y1='28' x2='68' y2='56' stroke='#c8bea6' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='38' x2='64' y2='57' stroke='#c8bea6' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Sail bottom fold -->
  <polygon points='22,58 50,58 78,58 50,54' fill='#ede4d4'/>
  <polygon points='22,58 50,58 50,54' fill='#faf4ea'/>
  <polygon points='78,58 50,58 50,54' fill='#ccc2ae'/>
  
  <!-- Hull top edge highlight -->
  <line x1='18' y1='68' x2='50' y2='58' stroke='#fffbf5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='82' y2='68' stroke='#d8ceb8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  
  <!-- Bow point highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,58 46,62 54,62' fill='#f0e8d8' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Light reflection on water -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='78' rx='8' ry='2' fill='#4a8ab8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='80' rx='6' ry='1.5' fill='#4a8ab8' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Small wave near hull -->
  <path d='M25 74 Q30 71 35 74' fill='none' stroke='#3a7aa0' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M60 77 Q65 74 70 77' fill='none' stroke='#3a7aa0' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Mast top highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#fff8ee'/>
</svg>
